basis: 1f_view.png: x/y anchors from outer wall faces matched to overall 15000x8000mm dimension lines (top and left chains). Partition centerlines measured from paired wall-line pixel profiles (rooms1-3 north row x~888/1353, rooms4-6 south row same x). Corridor is the open band between pixel y=600 and y=800 (north/south interior walls), spanning full building width, with door openings to each of the 6 perimeter rooms plus the west exterior main entrance. Window/door pixel spans measured directly from cyan opening ink and arc endpoints in the original drawing.
